title: Explicit flat single pairings and their compatibility proposition
statement: Let B be a symmetric closed monoidal Grothendieck abelian coefficient category with additive tensor and functorial flat resolutions, and v:Xprime to X a scheme map whose inverse image preserves flat sheaves. Write S for degree-zero inclusion and mu(L,M) for the prescribed singleFunctorObjTensorIso(L,M).hom when L is flat. Define the flat pairing of f:L tensor M to N as mu(L,M);S(f). Define the derived tensor pair map as tensoring its two arrows, and the single pullback map of b:vstar(L) to Lprime as gamma(L);Sprime(b), for the canonical single/pullback comparison gamma. EtaleFlatSingleTensorCompatibility(v) is the proposition with three universally quantified fields: ordinary associativity equations f tensor 1;g;a=associator;1 tensor h;k induce the corresponding derived pairing equations with the canonical derived associator (L,M and the intermediate left factor are flat); ordinary symmetry equations beta;g;a=f induce the corresponding equations with the canonical derived signed symmetry (L,M flat); and ordinary pullback squares vstar(f);d=delta;(b tensor c);g induce the corresponding equations with the canonical derived inverse-image tensor comparison and the specified single/pullback maps (L and Lprime flat). These are exactly the explicit equations in the attached structure declaration. The notions of sheaves, derived categories, tensor, flatness, exact inverse image and symmetry are respectively [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves], [def-weil-abstract-derived-category], [def-kun-derived-tensor], [prop-weil-pbc-inverse-image-modules-exact], [def-pc-flat-sheaf-modules], [lem-kun-tensor-sym].
